newsitem.title: UK: Ireland govt hails Orange Order march decision.
newsitem.headline: Ireland govt hails Orange Order march decision.

text.p: The Irish government on Thursday hailed the Orange Order decision to call off flashpoint parades in Northern Ireland at the weekend.
A spokesman for Prime Minister Bertie Ahern said: "The government welcomes this development."
"It is a very positive gesture by the Orange Order," the spokesman said in a statement read to Reuters in Belfast.
"The government believes that it deserves an equally positive response from nationalists," the statement said.

Catholic Irish nationalists bitterly opposed the parades by the Protestant organisation and had called for mass protests to block and picket Saturday's parades, raising fears of further violent confrontation.
